wacc.source: Assumption: CAPM with EUR 10Y AAA yield 3.266% (ECB, 2026-11-05); Damodaran Europe Beverage (Alcoholic) unlevered beta (cash-corrected) 0.432 relevered at industry D/E 0.594 gives ~0.65; ERP 5.27% gives cost of equity ~6.7%; pre-tax cost of debt 5.18%, after tax ~3.9%; weights 63/37 give ~5.6%; rounded up to 6.0% (Damodaran industry cost of capital 5.93%). Note: terminal value is ~82% of EV, inherent to a 5-year horizon with a low WACC-g spread; USD cash flows vs EUR risk-free rate is a mismatch to review.

terminal_growth.source: Assumption: long-run inflation-like growth, below the 3.27% risk-free rate.
